messages:
chris: Just finished the canary roll for v2.3.4 -> noticed synth heartbeat divergence in eu-west1 around +2m after rollout :thinking_face:
deploy-bot: Canary completed, 5% -> 100% in 6m. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/5750012345 :robot_face:
maya: saw that too — synth p95 spiked from 120ms -> 230ms on the kv-warmup probe. real user p95 mostly flat.
ivy: confirming - metric correlation shows increase in kv-cache misses by ~12% at the same time.
chris: wondering if this is noisy prefilling behavior or something with the quantized variant scheduling. did we switch model variant on that route?
maya: route embed-eu pinned to model-modelx:quant2 for this rollout, yes. previous stable was modelx:fp16.
oncall: FYI runbook step 3 suggests holding rollout if synthetic p95 > 200ms for >3m and cache-miss delta >10%.
alex: we hit 2m and 12% delta. I'd vote for a temporary pinback to previous variant on eu-west1 while we triage. low blast radius.
chris: agreed. can we do a regional pin instead of full rollback?
maya: yes, we can pin route config for eu-west1 to modelx:fp16 with the routing API. command: ```rdctl routes pin --route embed-eu --region eu-west1 --variant modelx:fp16 --reason "postdeploy synth heartbeat spike"```
ivy: I'll run a quick smoke after pin. smoke-bot, can you kick the embed-kv-warmup probe for eu-west1?
smoke-bot: scheduled synthetic run "embed-kv-warmup" in eu-west1. ETA ~45s. Results will be posted here.
chris: doing the pin now (running rdctl)...
chris: done. returned 200. config version bumped.
maya: smoke-bot results: pre-pin p95 230ms, post-pin p95 118ms, kv-miss delta fell back to 3%. :thumbsup:
ivy: thanks. I'll keep sampling for the next 10m to ensure no tail effects.
chris: hold the global rollout for now, update release notes that eu-west1 was pinned back to fp16 due to synth-heartbeat latency spike.
alex: filing a follow-up issue for quant2 warmup behavior and model variant scheduler to look at KV warmup ordering. link: https://tracker.redwood.internal/ISSUE-8142
maya: re-enable global rollout after 20m observation window if stable. posting a short release note: "v2.3.4: eu-west1 temporarily pinned to fp16 due to observed synthetic probe latency increase; investigating quant2 warmup pattern."
oncall: adding to postdeploy checklist: add a KV miss heatmap to quickcheck dashboard to catch this earlier.
chris: thanks everyone. will keep thread open for 30m and then close if no regressions. :eyes:
